description: This file defines the iFrameDashlet class for SuiteCRM, extending Dashlet, and manages the display and configuration of an iframe-based dashboard widget, including URL validation and rendering.

classes.name: iFrameDashlet
classes.description: A dashboard widget class for embedding iframes with configurable URL, height, and auto-refresh options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the dashlet with options, setting URL, title, height, and auto-refresh.

methods.name: checkURL
methods.description: Validates the URL scheme against allowed schemes (http, https).

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Prepares and returns the configuration options interface for the dashlet.

methods.name: saveOptions
methods.description: Saves user-provided configuration options for the dashlet.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the dashlet, embedding an iframe if URL is valid, or an error message otherwise.
